_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. fable.co declares a Tailwind-style token layer in its app bundle (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant palettes and scales under core.*, and a semantic layer the stylesheet redeclares under a scoped `.dark` class — emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each scope resolves its own value (the dark set follows the declared var() chains; no captured public page paints .dark). Measured roles alias to the declared values they match.
